content: {"action":"escalate","reasoning":"The claim was denied CO-197 for missing prior authorization, and Silverbridge offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review. With no current payer response, another appeal is unavailable, and resubmission would not cure the authorization defect; billing the patient is not supported as contractual patient responsibility. A human specialist is therefore needed to pursue any plan-specific exception or determine the proper disposition."}
